exposure: absorbable subcuticular staples for caesarean section skin closure
subcuticular suture for caesarean section skin closure
cohort: 206 patients at least 18 years old and 24 weeks' gestation, undergoing caesarean section
finding: For caesarean section skin closure, absorbable subcuticular staples did not result in significantly different total operative times compared with sutures, but did result in shorter subcuticular skin closure time.
mod_finding: For caesarean section skin closure, absorbable subcuticular staples did not result in significantly different total operative times compared with sutures, but did result in shorter subcuticular skin closure time.
